exam_facts.result: Board-like rigidity, positive rebound tenderness indicating peritonitis.
Expected to show free air under the diaphragm, indicative of gastrointestinal perforation.
Hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL; hematocrit 34%; white blood cell count 14.8 × 10³/μL with 88% neutrophils, 6% bands, 4% lymphocytes; platelets 320 × 10³/μL

Sodium 136 mmol/L; potassium 3.4 mmol/L; chloride 98 mmol/L; bicarbonate 18 mmol/L; BUN 12 mg/dL; creatinine 1.1 mg/dL; glucose 142 mg/dL; albumin 3.1 g/dL; total protein 6.2 g/dL; AST 28 U/L; ALT 24 U/L; total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL
pH 7.31; pCO2 32 mm Hg; HCO3⁻ 15 mmol/L; base excess −10 mEq/L; PaO2 84 mm Hg on room air
PT 12.4 sec; INR 1.0; aPTT 28 sec; fibrinogen 380 mg/dL
Color: pale yellow; clarity: clear; specific gravity 1.018; pH 6.0; no RBCs, WBCs, nitrites, or bacteria; no casts; protein trace; glucose negative
No gallstones, no sonographic Murphy sign, common bile duct diameter 4 mm, no pericholecystic fluid; no evidence of acute cholecystitis or biliary obstruction
Patent superior mesenteric artery and vein; no thrombosis, no bowel wall thickening or pneumatosis, no mesenteric edema or stranding

exam_facts.test: Stool studies (including C. difficile toxin A/B PCR)
exam_facts.result: Negative for Clostridioides difficile toxin A and B; negative for Salmonella, Shigella, Campylobacter, and E. coli O157:H7 by multiplex PCR
Moderate amount of anechoic free fluid in the perihepatic space and pelvis; no discrete mass or abscess; no evidence of hepatic or splenic laceration

exam_facts.test: Contrast-enhanced CT abdomen and pelvis (with oral and IV contrast)
exam_facts.result: Pneumoperitoneum with linear and crescentic lucencies tracking along the undersurface of the left hemidiaphragm and within the lesser sac; focal discontinuity of the anterior gastric wall near the lesser curvature at the incisura angularis, with adjacent fat stranding and localized extraluminal contrast extravasation; no evidence of malignancy, no gastric wall mass, no lymphadenopathy; no diverticular disease or colonic perforation
